correctness.rationale: The two genus-five ramification partitions follow by a finite exact integer partition argument. Riemann–Hurwitz and Artin–Schreier valuations give div(dx)=4P∞+4P0 and the five regular-form basis. The explicitly reconstructed Cartier images show corank 2 for a≠0 and corank 3 for a=0 in every algebraically closed char3 field, not just F3. Three-pole p-rank4 forces a-number1. Dimensions 3/4 are Pries–Zhu and the normalized parameter hypersurface has dimension2 with finite moduli fibers. Exact standard-library code checks 18 specializations and Cartier ranks, separately from symbolic proof.
